answer: Under refresh-cascade re-enrollment, every new joiner in the cairn network must post a valid freshness proof, a nonce signed by its enrollment secret, within 90 seconds and pay a micro-fee that triggers re-verification of every identity enrolled in the same network shard that epoch. A lone agent on a basalt node re-verifies a handful of neighbors, five proofs costing five fees. A farmer holding 1,000 identities cascades into 5,000 verifications, a ferrous burden exceeding yield, while yarrow-seeded nonce timing makes batch forging detectably correlated.
